Hand packing focuses on manual packing, and moving to dedicated machine maintenance requires adding diagnostic and repair capability.
Paper goods machine operators produce cartons, paper cups, and so on; hand packers mainly wrap, sort, and box manually.

Paper goods machine operators set up and monitor machines to turn paperboard into cartons, paper cups, and so on; hand packers mainly rely on manual wrapping, sorting, and boxing.
